name: New Mexico veterans: state field offices for claims help
organization: New Mexico Department of Veterans’ Services
description: Free help with VA claims, pension and survivor benefits and New Mexico state benefits from New Mexico Department of Veterans’ Services veteran service officers. New Mexico has no county veterans offices: 17 field offices, from Farmington to Las Cruces and Clovis, each serve a set of counties.
next_step: Choose your county for its field office, or call the department’s toll-free line, 866-433-8387.
constraints: Call to schedule before you travel; the field offices page prints no office hours.
Torrance County is not assigned to an office on the department’s page; call the toll-free line.

organization: New Mexico Aging and Long-Term Services Department, Aging and Disability Resource Center (ADRC)
description: The state Aging and Disability Resource Center helps older adults, adults with disabilities and caregivers find in-home services, Medicaid home and community-based services, benefits counseling and caregiver support. Military service is not required.
next_step: Call 800-432-2080, Monday–Friday 7:45 a.m.–5 p.m. Mountain time, or choose a county above for its Area Agency on Aging.

name: New Mexico Long-Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
organization: New Mexico Aging and Long-Term Services Department, Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
description: Independent advocacy for residents of nursing homes and other long-term care facilities.
next_step: Call the Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program at 866-451-2901. To report abuse, neglect or exploitation of an adult, call Adult Protective Services at 866-654-3219, 24 hours a day. In an emergency, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing agency.

name: Free legal help for New Mexico veterans and older adults
organization: Legal Resources for the Elderly Program (State Bar Foundation); New Mexico Legal Aid; Senior Citizens’ Law Office
description: The Legal Resources for the Elderly Program is a free statewide legal helpline for New Mexicans 55 and older, with no income limits, run by the State Bar Foundation with the Aging and Long-Term Services Department. New Mexico Legal Aid gives free civil legal help to people with low incomes. In Bernalillo County and nearby, the Senior Citizens’ Law Office also helps older adults.
next_step: If you are 55 or older, call the Legal Resources for the Elderly Program at 800-876-6657 (505-797-6005 in Albuquerque). For other civil legal help, call New Mexico Legal Aid’s statewide intake line, 833-545-4357. In the Albuquerque area, the Senior Citizens’ Law Office is at 505-265-2300.
constraints: No help with criminal cases.
New Mexico Legal Aid screens by income and case type.

name: VA health care systems serving New Mexico
description: Most New Mexico veterans are served by VA New Mexico health care (Raymond G. Murphy VA Medical Center, 1501 San Pedro Drive SE, Albuquerque; 505-265-1711 or 800-465-8262) and its clinics. In Doña Ana County, the Las Cruces clinic is run by VA El Paso; in the east, the Clovis clinic is run by VA Amarillo and the Hobbs clinic by VA West Texas.
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic. Not enrolled yet? Ask your field office’s veteran service officer for help applying.
constraints: Which system serves you depends on where you live; VA’s locator shows the right clinic.

name: Choices Center for Independent Living (Roswell)
description: A Center for Independent Living: disability-led help with daily living skills, peer support, advocacy, assistive technology referrals and moving from a nursing home back to the community. Any age and any disability; military service is not required.
next_step: Call with your county and goals. Ask about intake, home access, independent living skills or help leaving a facility.
constraints: A Center for Independent Living is a community support organization, not a residential care facility. Services depend on assessment and availability.
Office: 110 W. Country Club Road, Suite 4, Roswell, NM 88201.
